# iNNfo Technical Documentation
> Specifications, core engine packages, the domain console, and agent MCP integration.

## Documentation Index

- [Home](README): Documentation entry point and overview.
- [nn-core](nn-core): Core parser, resolver, validator, and AST engine (@cognnitive/nn-core).
- [nn-mcp](nn-mcp): Model Context Protocol server (@cognnitive/nn-mcp) exposing iNNfo capabilities to AI agents.
- [OpenCode Agent (Legacy)](opencode-nn-agent): Legacy integration guide for OpenCode and Antigravity agent workflows.
- [Vocabulary](vocabulary): Canonical ubiquitous language dictionary across defiNNition, iNNfo, bluepriNNts, kNNowledge, and domaiNNs.
- [Ecosystem](ecosystem): Holistic view of cogNNitive ecosystem layers (defiNNition, iNNfo, bluepriNNts, kNNowledge, domain console, agent skills).
- [Specifications](specifications): Formal specification of the defiNNition meta-specification, iNNfo format (V_0-5-0), and Level 2 bluepriNNt layers.
- [OKF Alignment](ecosystem?id=open-knowledge-format-alignment): Conceptual inspiration and architectural alignment with the Open Knowledge Format (OKF v0.1), plus future compatibility via a dedicated export mechanism.
- [Discipline Overlaps](discipline-overlaps): How cogNNitive overlaps with established disciplines — Model-Driven Engineering, Knowledge Management, Enterprise Architecture, Ontology Engineering, Docs as Code, and Personal Knowledge Management.
- [External Tooling & Integrations](integrations): Integration of independent external tools (MCP vs CLI), with the WaveSpeed image-generation case study.
- [Why cogNNitive](value-proposition): The problem with chatting straight to a general LLM, and the four pillars cogNNitive addresses — efficiency, traceability, review comfort, and no vendor lock-in.
- [Usage](usage): Practical workflow examples, kNNowledge authoring, and CLI usage.
- [Relationships & Connections](relationships): Graph relationships, bidirectional edges, and matrices in iNNfo.
- [The Knowledge Lifecycle](knowledge-lifecycle): How kNNowledge enters, is structured, exported to artifacts/, changed via changes/*_changes_NN.md, and traced end to end.
- [Sources, Citations & Lineage](sources-citations-lineage): How the pipeline tracks where kNNowledge comes from, with three terms — Source, Citation, Lineage.
- [Import Modes & Dynamic Sources](import-modes): How new files enter the domaiNN — one-off, snapshot series, watched folders, and external connectors (APIs) — and how the impact check keeps living sources from silently breaking citations.
- [Building a Domain from Scratch](domain-from-scratch): A hands-on worked example: scaffold an empty domaiNN, ingest sources, author kNNowledge with citations, export an artifact, apply a changeset via apply_change, and read the lineage record.
- [Lifecycle Walkthrough (Case Study)](lifecycle-walkthrough): End-to-end walkthrough of the 3-phase kNNowledge lifecycle using the Ghostbusters Inc. sample domaiNN and changeset review flow.
- [Reviewer Guide](reviewer-guide): How domain experts and stakeholders review kNNowledge in domaiNN_console.html and export changes/*_changes_NN.md changesets for apply_change.
- [Tags & Open Taxonomy](tags-and-taxonomy): Cross-cutting categorization with the built-in tags Field, deterministic FNV-1a tag colors, and multi-dimensional console filtering.
- [Collaboration with Git](collaboration-git): Gated domaiNN-to-Git review workflow with private defaults, branch-per-change PR gates, version map, and offline backup.
- [Domain Backup Strategies](workspace-backups): Layered domaiNN safety model: user-led snapshots, full-tree recursive migration backups with SHA-256 manifests, and the optional Git collaboration layer.
- [Editing kNNowledge by Hand](manual-editing-risks): Why hand-editing kNNowledge documents is unsupported for routine changes, what silently breaks (duplicate slugs, hash drift, dangling references), and the changeset-based alternatives.
- [Blueprints Overview](templates): Overview of the iNNfo Level 2 bluepriNNts that define schemas for a domaiNN.
- [Video Script Blueprint](template-video): The video-script bluepriNNt (V_0-2-2) and its generated scenes and artifacts.
- [Offline Consoles](offline-consoles): How generated consoles (domaiNN_console.html) boot offline from file:// via static script tags and the vendored nn-console.bundle.js UMD bundle.
- [Console Needs & Visuals](console-needs-and-visuals): Capability needs, changeset export (changes/*_changes_NN.md), and bluepriNNt-driven concept color/icon in generated consoles.
- [Console UI Kit](console-ui-kit): Design tokens and presentational components (InnfoUI) shared by generated consoles.
- [Validator Behavior](validator-behavior): Deterministic validation (validate_knowledge, validate_blueprint, check_domain), differential baseline_path output, version inference, and domaiNN-first resolution.
